column8: The bounded Selection response is consumed through the real-query result path with immutable executor and predicate evidence; exact Go cop runtime-stat update and merge behavior remains open.
The bounded Selection query owns one lazy response and transfers it once into the record set; the complete Go channel-iterator construction, concurrency, close, and error matrix remains open.
Signed-BIGINT Selection rows and empty results are decoded through the lazy result iterator; the complete Go channel read, kill, memory, warning, and error matrix remains open.
The bounded Selection result preserves projection offsets and exact signed-BIGINT rows; complete Go iteration, close, feedback, runtime-statistics, memory, and paging parity remains open.

A planner-built TableScan-plus-Selection request reaches the injected transport with exact DAG bytes, full table ranges, start timestamp, keep-order policy, and query operation. The complete Go cop-client request-family and error matrix remains open.

Clustered signed-BIGINT handle and stored-column projections remain correctly decoded while predicates may use projection or predicate-only scan inputs. Missing-handle repair and inconsistent-index recovery remain open.
The bounded direct table path preserves exact projected rows under Selection; index/table consistency checking, index lookup, repair diagnostics, and all inconsistent-index branches remain open.

One nonpartitioned configured table sends exact Selection DAG and decodes rows through the production-shaped reader. Partition selection, random partition readers, index lookup, and concurrency remain open.

The bounded table reader exposes exact executor kinds, predicate count, output offsets, and transport request state. Index-lookup statistics, back-table accounting, and the complete runtime-stat matrix remain open.
The configured nonpartitioned table path preserves signed-BIGINT predicate and result semantics. Partitioned index join, index lookup, correlated range rebuilding, and join execution remain open.
The Selection request retains the existing no-paging admission and immutable request envelope. Go paging-size growth, continuation, thresholds, and all paged response behavior remain open.
The Selection query uses the maintained production PD and RegionCache routing path. Adaptive closest-read scope choice, labels, TiFlash policy, and complete replica-selection behavior remain open.

The bounded request carries one canonical full signed-handle range and keep-order policy into transport. Multiple-range sorting, paging continuation, descending scans, and partition groups remain open.

The production Selection path reaches RegionCache and maintained TiKV transport with observable physical publication. Complete batching-by-store, multi-region grouping, concurrency, and batch fallback remain open.
The bounded Selection path preserves request execution-summary policy and consumes real responses. Coprocessor cache admission, cache keys, hit accounting, and execution-info interaction remain open.
TableScan and Selection are pushed as an exact TiKV executor list for the direct table reader. Index lookup, back-table tasks, index-side pushdown, and partition combinations remain open.

The bounded nonpartitioned table reader preserves exact signed-BIGINT rows and predicate semantics. Skewed partition scheduling, index-lookup merge, concurrency, and partition result ordering remain open.
